title: Span snapshotting and late-arrival rollups for latency/cost reconciliation
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Adds span snapshotting and late-arrival aggregation to improve correlation between observed latency and token-level cost. Includes dashboard updates and tuned alerts to reduce false positives from delayed spans.
description: Motivation: In production SLO incidents we repeatedly observe a mismatch between per-request token cost and the latency signal in traces. Root cause analysis showed a class of late-arriving spans (network proxies, batching backpressure, kube-probe skew) that were being dropped from rollups or attributed to wrong time buckets, producing noisy alerts and misleading cost/latency dashboards. This PR introduces two complementary mechanisms: 1) span snapshotting: capture a compact immutable snapshot of span-relevant fields at emit time and persist it through the ingest path; 2) late-arrival rollups: a small aggregator that consumes late spans (within a configurable grace window) and folds them into downsampled rollups so dashboards and SLO reconciliation include them. Summary of changes: - server/telemetry/span_snapshotter.go: new component that serializes span snapshots (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, end_ts, token_cost_hint, route_hint, host_tag) and attaches a stable dedup key. (+214 -12) - telemetry/rollups/late_arrival_aggregator.py: aggregator that reads incoming late snapshots, dedups, and writes to the same rollup store used by online rollups with a late-arrival flag. (+378 -0) - telemetry/rollups/schema_v3 migration: wire adapters to accept snapshot payloads and preserve original event timestamp and emit-time metadata. (+86 -22) - dashboards/cost_reconciliation_dashboard.json: new panels showing reconciled latency vs token-cost including a late-arrival adjustment toggle. (+32 -0) - pkg/metrics/registry.go: added gauges and histograms for snapshot ingestion lag, dedup rate, and late-arrival processing time. (+56 -8) - docs/observability/span-snapshotting.md: design doc and rollout checklist. (+45 -0) - tests/telemetry/test_snapshotting_end2end.go and tests/telemetry/test_late_arrival_rollup.py: new unit + integration tests that simulate delayed spans and verify no double-counting. (+432 -389) Implementation notes: - Snapshot shape kept intentionally minimal to avoid high cardinality: only route_hint and host_tag (small enum-like tags) are included for downstream attribution. token_cost_hint is an approximate integer bucket used for cost reconciliation; the canonical token accounting continues to live in the billing pipeline. - Deduplication: snapshots carry a deterministic key (trace_id:span_id:emit_ts_bucket) to avoid duplicates when replays or retries occur. - Grace window: default 5 minutes configurable via TELEMETRY_LATE_ARRIVAL_WINDOW. This is intentionally conservative for first rollout; can be reduced after observation. Testing: - Unit tests cover serialization, dedup, and late folding. - Integration test runs a local rollup worker that processes delayed messages and asserts final rollup values match expected sums. - Ran an end-to-end replay with 72h of production traffic (sampled) in staging; late-arrival inclusion changed reconciled latency->cost correlation from 0.72 to 0.93 (Pearson), and reduced alert noise on the token-latency divergence alert by 58% in a 48h window. Backwards compatibility: - Old rollup consumers ignore the new snapshot payload; adapters are added in the rollup store to accept both v2 events and snapshot-wrapped v3 events. - No change to API surfaces used by customers. Rollout plan: 1) Feature flag default off in main for 2 days (canary 10% traffic to dedicated workers). 2) Enable snapshotting in staging with late-arrival aggregator running against historical replay. 3) Enable in production for non-critical routes (low qps) for 24h. 4) Gradual ramp to 100% and reduce grace window if stable. Observability and alert tuning: - New metrics: telemetry.snapshot.emit_lag_ms, telemetry.snapshot.dedupe_rate, telemetry.late_arrival.process_time_ms. - Alert changes: token-latency divergence alert now uses reconciled_rollup when reconciled_rollup completeness > 90% and falls back to original signal otherwise. - Added dashboard panels to help on-call visualize late-arrival contributions. Caveats and limitations: - This does not fix deeply delayed events > 24h; those will still be missing. - Snapshotting increases event ingestion by ~3% in staging tests; we will monitor EC2/GPU egress costs and consider sampling if necessary. Merge notes: - CI was green after one flaky telemetry test rerun. - Code reviewed by Marcus Chen and Priya Nair; performance review by Jonah Reyes. - Migration steps for rollup store deployed in the same merge. - Merge method: squash.

Priya Nair: Concern about double-counting during replay; requested deterministic dedup. Asked for explicit tests simulating a retry storm.
Elena Park: Added deterministic dedup key and new test that simulates 5x replay; verified dedupe_rate > 99.9%.
Jonah Reyes: Reviewed performance implications; requested histogram metrics on process_time_ms and a gate to disable snapshotting if processing latency spikes.
Elena Park: Added telemetry.late_arrival.process_time_ms and an env gate TELEMETRY_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED (default true during rollout steps).
